followup_explanation:
This was a friendly, benign math tutoring request — SAT trig prep, warm tone, no harm-adjacent or ethically fraught content. So the safety/sensitivity preference dimensions (where the two models differ most) don't come into play here.

That leaves capability as the deciding factor. Petrel-235B is stronger across essentially every relevant benchmark: higher MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 55.6), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 82.7), and its internal evals are higher too. For a math problem requiring clear step-by-step reasoning and explanation, Petrel's stronger quantitative reasoning (GPQA, MMLU-Pro) and comparable-or-better support/instruction-following scores make it the better fit.

Lapwing's distinguishing trait is a strong appetite for open-ended creative invention and an aversion to harm-adjacent content — neither of which is relevant to a straightforward trig tutoring task. So there was no preference-based reason to prefer it, and capability tipped it clearly toward Petrel.
